merged_units.en_quote: A buyer from a high-risk or uncooperative jurisdiction, one lacking an established local presence or legitimate reason for purchasing property, poses an additional risk.

merged_units.en_quote: These agencies should also share information with their international counterparts to handle crossborder money laundering and terrorist financing.
